q.line: You said our love was sacred
stanza: You said our love was sacred
But you left me alone to make it
You want to come back again someday (Someday)
But, darling, here's what I say

partner.line: You want to come back again someday (Someday)

q.line: So I set free the hearts filled with hatred, keep our bodies sacred
q.linePrev: So I set free our children, may good karma keep them with God
q.lineNext: As I set free all you abusers, this is transformation
